attchmntText: Pursuant to Regulations 30 and 33 read with Schedule Ill of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ("SEBI Listing Regulations"), we wish to inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company, at their meeting held today, i.e., November 12th November, 2026, has, inter alia, considered and approved the following:1. Pursuant to Regulation 32(6) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended read with Regulation 41(4) of the SEBI (Issue of Capital  and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018, as amended, we are enclosing herewith the Monitoring Agency Report, dated 12th November, 2026, issued by CARE Ratings Limited ("Monitoring Agency"), for the quarter  and half year ended September 30, 2026, in respect of utilization of proceeds raised through the Initial Public Offer ("IPO") of Sunshine Pictures Limited (the "Company").The aforesaid report has been placed before the Audit Committee and the Board of Directors of the Company and duly noted/approved at their respective meetings held on November 11, 2026. The said report  is enclosed herewith as Annexure- A and shall also be made available on the Company's website at www.sunshinepictures.in
voiceSummary: Sunshine Pictures Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on November 12, 2026. The Board noted the Monitoring Agency Report issued by CARE Ratings Limited for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, regarding the utilization of proceeds from the Initial Public Offer. The report details a deviation where the company paid GST of Rs.1.44 crore related to Offer for Sale expenses, which was not explicitly covered under the prospectus object of funding working capital requirements. Management confirmed this amount would be recovered from selling shareholders. The company utilized Rs.66.03 crore for working capital, including payments for the film Samuk. Rs.10.40 crore was used for general corporate purposes, specifically self-assessment tax. Rs.12.82 crore was spent on issue-related expenses. Total utilization for the quarter was Rs.89.25 crore, leaving Rs.83.55 crore unutilized.

voiceSummary: Sunshine Pictures Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 12th November, 2026. The Board approved the appointment of D.M. voiceSummary: Sunshine Pictures Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on November 12, 2026. The Board approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a profit before tax of 156.70 lakh for the half year. Total income stood at 657.21 lakh. The Audit Committee and Board confirmed no deviation in the utilization of IPO proceeds, except for a GST payment of 1.44 crore on Offer for Sale expenses, which management considers a deviation. The company completed its IPO of equity shares at an issue price of Rs. 2360 per share. Shares were listed on NSE and BSE on August 25, 2026. The statutory auditors, M/s. Satyanarayan Goyal & Co. LLP, issued a Limited Review Report. The meeting commenced at 5.30 PM and concluded at 6.30 PM.
